hints.title: Dependency Graph Formulation
hints.text: A recipe can be prepared only when all of its ingredient dependencies are met.

hints.title: In-Degree Initialization
hints.text: Count prerequisites for each recipe that are not already present in the initial supply set.

hints.title: Kahn Propagation
hints.text: Whenever all ingredients for a recipe become available, add it to the ready queue and unlock dependent recipes.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(V + E) topological sort with Kahn algorithm
complexity.space: O(V + E) dependency graph and in-degree table
variables: E: total ingredients across all recipes
complexity.notes: Kahn algorithm decrements prerequisite in-degrees as available supplies and cooked recipes expand.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursively expanding ingredient dependencies can repeat work or cycle endlessly.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Topological sorting processes each dependency edge in amortized linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should model recipes as graph nodes and resolve dependencies topologically.
